import pandas as pd

# Load the capital dataset
capital_df = pd.read_csv('/data/capital.csv')
capital_df.head()

# Drop the 'group' and 'color' columns
capital_df = capital_df.drop(columns=['group', 'color'])

# Filter the data for the Younger Bronze Age (1100-500 BCE)
young_bronze_age_df = capital_df[(capital_df['BCE'] >= 500) & (capital_df['BCE'] <= 1100)]

# Extract the PC1 values for Pottery Form (ZKeform) and Pottery Decoration (Zkeverz)
pc1_values = young_bronze_age_df[['ZKeform', 'Zkeverz']]

# Display the first few rows of the filtered data
pc1_values.head()

# Extract data for the beginning of the Younger Bronze Age (1100 BCE)
beginning_period_df = young_bronze_age_df[young_bronze_age_df['BCE'] == 1100]

# Extract data for the subsequent time horizons (1000 to 500 BCE)
subsequent_horizons_df = young_bronze_age_df[(young_bronze_age_df['BCE'] >= 500) & (young_bronze_age_df['BCE'] < 1100)]

# Display the first few rows of the beginning period data
beginning_period_df.head()
